title: 最 (zuì) in Chinese: "The Most" – HSK 2 Grammar with Examples
description: How to use 最 (zuì) for "the most" and "-est" in Chinese: word order, 最 with 喜欢, 最好的朋友, questions, common mistakes and 14 HSK 2 examples.
lede: 最 (zuì) means "the most". Put it in front of an adjective or a verb like 喜欢 and you get the English "-est" or "most": 最高 is "the tallest", 最喜欢 is "like best". It is a key word of HSK 2.

paras: 最 always comes directly before the adjective. You don't need 是, and you can't add 很 or 非常: 他最高 is right, 他最很高 is wrong. The group you are comparing within usually comes first, for example 我们家 (in our family) or 三个人里 (of the three people).

examples.py: Wǒmen jiā wǒ gēge zuì gāo.
examples.en: My older brother is the tallest in our family.

examples.py: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài zuì hǎochī.
examples.en: The food at this restaurant is the best.

sections.h2: 最 + 喜欢, 想, 爱
paras: 最 also goes before verbs of liking and wanting, such as 喜欢, 想 and 爱. 我最喜欢 means "I like best" or "my favourite is".
The most common mistake is to follow English word order and put 最 after the verb: 我喜欢最茶. 最 must come before the verb: 我最喜欢茶.

examples.en: Where would you most like to go?
Rice is what I love eating most.

paras: To say "the best friend" or "the biggest room", use 最 + adjective + 的 + noun. The 的 is needed: say 最好的朋友, not 最好朋友. 最 can never go straight before a noun.
If you want to use 是, end the sentence with 的: 他是最高的. 他是最高 on its own sounds unfinished; 他最高 is simpler.

examples.py: Tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyou.

examples.zh: 这是我们学校最大的教室。
examples.py: Zhè shì wǒmen xuéxiào zuì dà de jiàoshì.
examples.en: This is the biggest classroom in our school.

paras: To ask which one is the most, use 谁 (who) or 哪个 (which one) before 最. The answer keeps the same word order: 你们班谁最高？ 我们班王明最高。
最不 + verb or adjective means "the least": 我最不喜欢 is "what I like least".

examples.en: Who is the tallest in your class?

examples.py: Zhè sān ge lǐ, nǎge zuì hǎo?
examples.en: Which of these three is the best?
Rainy days are what I like least.

paras: Three common words start with 最. 最近 means "recently" or "lately", 最后 means "in the end" or "last", and 最好 before a verb means "you'd better". Like other time words, 最近 and 最后 go at the start of the sentence or right after the subject.

examples.zh: 最后我们坐出租车回家了。
examples.py: Zuìhòu wǒmen zuò chūzūchē huí jiā le.
examples.en: In the end we took a taxi home.
You'd better go and see a doctor.

worksheet.title: 最 (zuì) Worksheet: HSK 2 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 最 (zuì) worksheet for HSK 2: 20 exercises (choose 最 or 很, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.instructions: Write 最 or 很 in each gap. The English tells you what the sentence means.

items.en: Of the three of us, he is the tallest.
The weather is very nice today.
This is my favourite song.
Who is the tallest in your class?
This piece of clothing is very pretty, so I bought it.
He is my best friend.
She speaks Chinese very well.
Where we live, January is the coldest month.
I'm very busy and don't have time.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence with 最.

items.en: Tea is my favourite drink.
He is my best friend.
Who is the tallest in your class?
This dish is the cheapest.
Where would you most like to go?
Fish is the food I like least.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: Apples are my favourite.
This one is the tastiest.
She is my best friend.
My mum is the busiest person in our family.
answers: 我们家我妈妈是最忙的。

items.en: I think this dish is the tastiest.
